Optical System: Infinity corrected optical system or similar technology to ensure uniform illumination th roughout the Field of view. 2. Upgradability: The quoted system should be onsite upgradable to full like motorized/manual 8 positi ons or higher fluorescence filter turret, motorized/manual universal condenser with at least 7 positions, motorised 7 positions or higher DIC nosepiece, 22 Header Microscope system or higher etc. 3. Focus: Coaxial coarse & fine focusing with at least 25 mm stage stroke with coarse adjustment limit stop per. Fine focusing knob with minimum adjustment gradations of 1 μm or better. Torque adjustment for coa rse adjustment knobs. 4. Illumination: The microscope should have an ergonomic stand with high intensity - minimum 14W or be tter LED illumination system with minimum life of 50,000 hours or more. 5. Observation Tube: Ergonomic Tilting Trinocular tube having continuously variable tilting angle range of 5° - 35° or better provided with paired wide field eyepieces having at least 22 mm field of view with three way lights path distribution (0:100, 100:0, 20:80/50:50) for simultaneous viewing & imaging of specimens through the Eyepiece & Camera. 6. Eyepieces: Should be of at least 10X magnification, with diopter adjustment facility with FN 22 mm or hi gher. 7. Nosepiece: Septuple (7-positions) revolving nosepiece with a slot for analyzer or DIC slider. 8. Objectives: High quality optics with latest Infinity Colour Corrected System for high brightness, rich cont rast and color correction. All optics coated with anti-reflection / anti-fungal treatment. Objectives suitable f or bright field & fluorescence microscopy observation 9. The following objectives should be quoted:-

· Plan Apochromat 2X, N.A. 0.08 or higher, W.D. 6.2 mm or better. · Plan Apochromat 4X, N.A. 0.16 or higher, W.D. 13 mm or better. · Plan Achromat 10X Phase, N.A. 0.25 or better, W.D. 10.6 mm or better. · Plan Apochromat 10X, N.A. 0.40 or higher, W.D. 3.1 mm or better. · Plan Apochromat 20X, N.A. 0.80 or higher, W.D. 0.6 mm or better. · Plan Apochromat 40X, N.A. 0.95 or higher, W.D, 0.18 mm or better. · Plan Apochromat 60X Oil, spring loaded and oil free N.A. 1.42 or higher, W.D. 0.15 mm or better. Plan Ap ochromat 100X Oil, N.A. 1.45 or higher, W.D. 0.13 mm or better. · All the quoted Apochromat objectives should have transmittance of more than 90% from 410-700 nm. Transmission curve should be provided along with the quotation. 10. Analyzer & Polarizer: Analyzer & rotatable Polarizer should be standard part of the system. 11. Stage: Mechanical stage with ceramic coating, with double slide holding capacity. Travel range of at least 76 x 52 mm. Should have stage rotation of 270 degrees rotatable. 12. Neutral density filters for incident light to be quoted if required. Removable blue filter also to be provided for additional whiteness. 13. Condenser: At least 5 position Turret condenser for B.F, Phase contrast & Dark field (up to 40X). An addit ional Swing out condenser must be included without any additional cost. 14. Ten Head Attachment (1+9): Wide field binocular heads having tilting angle range of 5° - 35° or higher with paired wide field eyepieces of 22 mm or better. The ten head attachment should be equipped with LE D Pointer with two colors red & green. LED pointer freely moveable and move 360 degree rotatable. 15. Digital Imaging System: i. Type of sensor: ≥ 1" or (35.8 x 23.8mm), CMOS chip, more than 22 MP resolution, CMOS ca mera. ii. Sensor: CMOS with Cooling system: Peltier device (active cooling) for increased sensitivity f or fluorescence observation (on-screen) and imaging. iii. Sensitivity: ISO 200-1000; Bit depth of 12 bit iv. Live display: 7-10 FPS (at full resolution of 4K x 3K); > 60 FPS (at 1920 x 1080 / HD resolutio n). v. USB 3.0- PC interface, with Suitable Mount and adapter ad provide FOV ≥ 25 mm. vi. Pixel size at least 3.4 x 3.4 μm (+/- 0.1 μm) square or more. vii. All the necessary cables/power supply must be included. viii. Camera should work in color and monochrome as per sample and requirement. ix. The camera should have a functionality of capturing the image of complete slide by capturin g multiple images and stitching them together. This should be available with manual stage als o and no motorized stage is required. 16. Image Analysis Software: Image acquisition software should be user friendly, innovative, latest and sh ould be supplied with the system at no extra cost. Installation drivers should be supplied. The imaging soft ware should be capable of snap/movie acquisition, time lapse image acquisition, merging and unmerging o f multiple fluorescent channels, annotation, Document groups for side-by-side image comparison, Overlay multiple images, Tile view (multiple images in a single data set shown side-by- side), Geometry/combine/fil ter processing. scale bar, user experience customization, basic measurement and counting, interactive me asurement, etc. Microscope, camera & software should be from the same manufacturer for seamless integ ration and better compatibility. 17.
